summary: Frontend-only visual verification of two small changes: (1) header nav-logo now shows 'USGOLD' with small-print 'GYMNASTICS & CHEER ACADEMY' tagline underneath, and (2) About page 'Rooted in the community' callout watermark is contained within its box. Both changes verified working on Home and About pages. Logo navigation (About -> Home via logo click) works with client-side routing. No ErrorBoundary triggered. No horizontal page overflow on About (body.scrollWidth=1920, window.innerWidth=1920). Screenshot confirms 'USG' watermark sits fully inside the callout box on the right side without spilling outside.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Header logo text renders uppercase via CSS text-transform - inner_text() returns 'USGOLD\nGYMNASTICS & CHEER ACADEMY'. Use case-insensitive checks or check computed content. Both changes verified across Home and About routes. Radix dropdowns for Programs/Events not tested (out of scope for this iteration).
